mapper.select: SELECT task.* FROM task, empgroup_emp WHERE empgroup_emp.emp_id = #{empId} AND empgroup_emp.group_id = task.group_id AND task.status = 2
SELECT DISTINCT task.task_type FROM task, empgroup_emp WHERE empgroup_emp.emp_id = #{empId} AND empgroup_emp.group_id = task.group_id AND task.status = 2
SELECT DISTINCT fert_water.brand FROM task, empgroup_emp, fert_water WHERE empgroup_emp.emp_id = #{empId} AND empgroup_emp.group_id = task.group_id AND fert_water.type = 2

SELECT COUNT(fert_water.num) FROM task, empgroup_emp, fert_water WHERE empgroup_emp.emp_id = #{empId} AND empgroup_emp.group_id = task.group_id AND task.status = 2 AND fert_water.brand = #{fertType} AND fert_water.tree_id = task.tree_id
SELECT DISTINCT fert_water.brand FROM task, empgroup_emp, fert_water WHERE empgroup_emp.emp_id = #{empId} AND empgroup_emp.group_id = task.group_id AND fert_water.type = 3

SELECT task.* FROM task INNER JOIN area_info ON task.orchard_id = area_info.orchard_id INNER JOIN employee ON area_info.emp_id = employee.id WHERE task.orchard_id = #{orchardId} AND employee.id = #{empId} AND task.status = 1
SELECT fruit_tree.* FROM fruit_tree, area_info WHERE area_info.id = #{areaId} AND fruit_tree.area_id = area_info.id

SELECT e.name FROM employee e JOIN area_info ai ON ai.emp_id = e.id WHERE
( #{areaId} IS NOT NULL AND ai.id = #{areaId} ) OR
( #{areaId} IS NULL AND #{treeId} IS NOT NULL AND ai.id = (SELECT area_id FROM fruit_tree WHERE id = #{treeId}) ) LIMIT 1
SELECT task.* FROM task WHERE task.orchard_id = #{orchardId} AND task.status = 0
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM fruit.task WHERE task_type = #{type} AND status = 3
